purpose: Four contiguous 15-second provider-generated segments form one 60-second continuous transformation event. Continuation segments are frame-pinned to the previous segment; no independent proof clips or placeholder media are accepted.

shots.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic live-action-style video of one clearly adult fictional male laboratory subject in a clean, clinical observation room. Medium-wide front three-quarter composition, head through upper thighs visible, relaxed standing posture, controlled neutral expression, subtle breathing, cool white and blue industrial laboratory light. Establish a coherent athletic baseline with broad shoulders and natural connected anatomy. Use <IMAGE_0>, <IMAGE_1> and <IMAGE_2> only for paired pectoral shape, chest-hair distribution, forward projection and central separation; use <IMAGE_3> for overall scale, <IMAGE_4> for figure-to-room scale and <IMAGE_5> for garment behavior. Do not copy any reference person's identity, face, car or environment. Keep one fictional adult subject, same camera, lens, lighting and room throughout. A restrained serum activation begins near the end. No cuts, no sudden morph, no extra limbs, no text, no logo, non-explicit adult presentation.

sequence_policy.transformation_continuity: One continuous 60-second event across four provider segments. Each continuation segment pins its first frame to the previous segment's final frame.
sequence_policy.assembly: Assemble only the four verified provider-generated segments. Preserve frame-identical boundaries, then mix the approved soundtrack and produce the documented 1080p upscale.
